reason: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/controllers/create_account_controller.js:274-275, the guard checks result.errors && result.errors.email && result.values without verifying result.values.email, so pushObject(result.values.email) pushes undefined, null, or "" into rejectedEmails when the server omits or blanks values.email (e.g., app/controllers/users_controller.rb:199 returns nil/blank email when params[:email] is missing or empty). Impact is limited because emailValidation in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/controllers/create_account_controller.js:61-74 returns early when accountEmail is blank before calling rejectedEmails.contains(email).
